title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-10-26

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a low‑energy Sunday show with an intriguing opening instrumental and relaxed band banter.
ai_review.review: The SBD tape captures the October 26, 1969 Winterland set with crystal‑clear, fantastic sound quality that reviewers rave about. Musically the performance is seen as modest – the band sounds a bit tired after a hectic weekend, offering a laid‑back mood rather than fire, highlighted only by an unnamed opening instrumental reminiscent of Jorma’s style.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is rated excellent (≈4.5/5) while show performance is viewed as average to below‑average (≈2.5/5); weighted combination yields a mid‑range overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the sound "fantastic," "great" and "crisp" with no noted dropouts or mix problems. No audience bleed issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial show; set appears to be a low‑energy Sunday performance after a busy weekend, with the most notable moment being an opening instrumental that some liken to Jorma or Runaround Sue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His onstage banter notes a "long, weird weekend" and suggests the band was not in great shape, but they were having fun.
